subject: general
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1adf5d02bcac6e99d407d82bb1f562b83a252871704dfc19ad5e0f2d3bf1beca.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic:

Step I: Letter 'Q' is rotated one place in anticlockwise direction, and the 'Symbol' is getting rotated by 90 degree in each next images.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f36df648775e9e03fbd200f5ecdb43cc69dc8fa4600d4e014a3097c96d9aab25.png] 

Step II: Letter 'M' is changing its place and replaced by a new letter. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a160bd292ede7f0f50d45910c3c0ba22135344351d1b124cca2c684078c7e9a3.png] 

So, the complete series will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6aa17e3c3fc5e60a138700e0328f474672a6283d7bcdf9b7f34c7ec221595db3.png] 

So, option 2 will complete the series.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
